leftColumn.title: %K and %D Formulas
leftColumn.subtitle: High-Low Range Positioning
bullets: %D = 3-period simple moving average of %K
Measures exact percentile of close inside 14-period range

rightColumn.title: Fast vs Slow Stochastics
rightColumn.subtitle: Filtering Out Jittery Noise
bullets: Fast Stochastics is raw, volatile, and prone to whipsaws
Slow Stochastics replaces %K with original %D
Murphy: Slow version is the universal professional standard

beats.en_narration: George Lane's core thesis: in an uptrend prices close near the period high; in a downtrend near the low.

beats.hindi_tts: The definitive trade signal occurs when the %K line crosses the %D line beyond the 80 or 20 boundaries.
beats.en_subtitle: The definitive trade signal occurs when the %K line crosses the %D line beyond the 80 or 20 boundaries.

leftColumn.title: Execution Rules
leftColumn.subtitle: Trigger Zones: 80 / 20
bullets: Oversold Buy: %K crosses above %D from below 20
Overbought Sell: %K crosses below %D from above 80

rightColumn.title: Right-Hand Crossover
rightColumn.subtitle: Lane's Highest Quality Filter
bullets: Best signal: %D has already turned before %K crosses it
Crossing on the right side of %D's peak/trough prevents premature entries
D-divergence at extremes provides reliable reversal warning

beats.en_narration: The definitive trade signal occurs when the %K line crosses the %D line beyond the 80 or 20 boundaries.

beats.hindi_tts: Larry Williams %R is mathematically identical to Stochastics, but plotted inverted on a 0 to -100 scale.
beats.en_subtitle: Larry Williams %R is mathematically identical to Stochastics, but plotted inverted on a 0 to -100 scale.

leftColumn.title: Williams %R Engine
leftColumn.subtitle: %R = -100 * [(H14 - Close) / (H14 - L14)]
bullets: Measures distance between close and period high
0 to -20: Overbought Zone (close near ceiling)
-80 to -100: Oversold Zone (close near floor)

rightColumn.title: Anticipatory Failure Swings
rightColumn.subtitle: Peculiar Leading Behavior
bullets: Extreme sensitivity without extra smoothing
Often peaks out 1 to 2 days before the actual price turn
Failure to re-enter -20 or -80 signals exhaustion

beats.en_narration: Larry Williams %R is mathematically identical to Stochastics, but plotted inverted on a 0 to -100 scale.

beats.hindi_tts: When %R visits the oversold zone and punches back above -80, it fires an immediate buy trigger.
beats.en_subtitle: When %R visits the oversold zone and punches back above -80, it fires an immediate buy trigger.

leftColumn.title: The Negative Scale Logic
leftColumn.subtitle: Zero at top, -100 at bottom
bullets: Focuses on where bulls failed to close at high
Smoothly integrates with 14-period daily cycles

rightColumn.title: Entry Protocol
rightColumn.subtitle: Crossback Confirmation
bullets: Buy: Dips into -80 to -100, then rises above -80
Sell: Pushes into 0 to -20, then drops below -20
Avoids shorting runaway trends stuck at -5 to 0

beats.en_narration: When %R visits the oversold zone and punches back above -80, it fires an immediate buy trigger.

leftColumn.title: Weekly Chart (The Trend Master)
leftColumn.subtitle: Determines Market Bias & Tide
bullets: Weekly MACD > 0 & rising = Only long positions permitted
Weekly MACD < 0 & falling = Only short positions permitted
Completely filters out minor daily whipsaws

rightColumn.title: Daily Chart (The Precision Trigger)
rightColumn.subtitle: Times Pullbacks & Swings
bullets: Wait for daily oscillator to dip into oversold in a weekly bull
Buy as daily %K crosses %D upward
Maximize reward-to-risk ratio on tighter stops

steps: Slow Stochastics uses %K and %D to locate closes inside recent range
Right-hand %K crossovers beyond 80/20 filter out premature false signals
Larry Williams %R inverts the scale (0 to -100) to gauge close vs period high
Oscillators excel in trading ranges; they must submit to trend in runaway markets

MACD Histogram measures the line spread, leading actual signal line crosses
Dual-Timeframe: Weekly chart dictates directional bias, daily times entry pullbacks
Principle of Contrary Opinion: Over 80% consensus marks impending market tops
ui_state.bottomTakeaway: Use weekly trends as your filter, daily oscillators for your trigger, and sentiment extremes for major reversals.
